panels.title: PostgreSQL up
panels.description: 1 = selected databases reachable, 0 = at least one exporter cannot connect.

panels.title: Scrape targets down
panels.description: Prometheus PostgreSQL targets whose last scrape failed.

panels.title: Exporter scrape errors
panels.description: 1 = last exporter scrape failed, 0 = success.

panels.title: User query load errors
panels.description: 1 = custom queries.yaml could not be loaded, 0 = success.

panels.title: Collector failures
panels.description: Number of PostgreSQL exporter collectors that failed on the last scrape.

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: Slowest current PostgreSQL exporter scrape.

panels.title: Exporter collectors
panels.description: Per-collector success. Value mapping: 1 = OK, 0 = FAIL.

panels.title: Connections vs max
panels.description: Current backends compared with the configured max_connections.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: pg_stat_activity connections grouped by state.

panels.title: Long transactions
panels.description: Maximum age of an active transaction in seconds.

panels.title: Locks by mode
panels.description: pg_locks entries grouped by database and lock mode.

panels.title: Transactions
panels.description: Committed and rolled-back transactions per second.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio by database
panels.description: Buffer cache hit ratio. Higher is better.

targets.expr: sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{datname=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{datname=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{datname=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Rollback ratio
panels.description: Share of transactions that rolled back.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Overall buffer cache hit ratio.

panels.title: Temp files/s
panels.description: Temporary files created per second.

panels.title: Temp bytes/s
panels.description: Temporary bytes written per second.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Disk space used by each selected database.

panels.title: Largest tables
panels.description: Top 10 public tables by total relation size.

panels.title: Row changes by type
panels.description: Row changes over the selected dashboard time range.

panels.title: Top tables by row changes
panels.description: Top 10 public tables by inserts + updates + deletes over the selected range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (datname, relname) (increase(pg_stat_user_tables_n_tup_ins{datname=~"$database", schemaname="public"}[$__range]) + increase(pg_stat_user_tables_n_tup_upd{datname=~"$database", schemaname="public"}[$__range]) + increase(pg_stat_user_tables_n_tup_del{datname=~"$database", schemaname="public"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Index vs sequential scans
panels.description: Index scans vs sequential scans per second for the busiest public tables.

panels.title: Top queries by total time
panels.description: Top 10 statements by total execution time in the selected range.

panels.title: Slowest queries by mean time
panels.description: Top 10 statements by mean execution time.

panels.title: Most called queries
panels.description: Top 10 statements by number of calls in the selected range.

panels.title: Business table counts
panels.description: Current row counts in the main application database.

targets.expr: label_replace(cosmetics_db_products_total{database=~"$database"}, "entity", "Products", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(cosmetics_db_users_total{database=~"$database"}, "entity", "Users", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(cosmetics_db_collections_total{database=~"$database"}, "entity", "Collections", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(cosmetics_db_price_history_rows_total{database=~"$database"}, "entity", "Price history rows", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(cosmetics_db_unread_notifications_total{database=~"$database"}, "entity", "Unread notifications", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Pending jobs in the PostgreSQL-backed queues.

panels.title: Oldest pending job age
panels.description: Age of the oldest pending job in each queue.

panels.title: Last price update by store
panels.description: Seconds since the last price-history row for each store.

panels.title: Auth tables
panels.description: Current row counts in the separate authentication database.

panels.title: Store records by store
panels.description: Store records in the main database per store.
